requirements: Preserve exact native BitConverter Int32 key-byte-count prefix,unhashed UTF8 key bytes and complete formatter payload order/length.
Preserve independently owned output,including after input mutations and subsequent larger calls.
Exercise real public AddMvcCore/AddCacheTagHelper registrations,actual formatter/storage/MemoryDistributedCache,and DistributedCacheTagHelper.ProcessAsync cache-miss and subsequent hit.
Use explicit cache.Remove within every timed miss operation so the owning Encode path is actually reached;retain removal/lifecycle costs and avoid claiming pure encoder time for those cases.
Keep Decode,worker gating/cache keys/expiration/child rendering/defaults/public API/dependencies/TFMs unchanged.
Original/new semantic preservation rows pass on original and selected owner;frozen allocation goals supply expected original-red/selected-green resource evidence.

permanentTestBoundary.selected: Actual public tag-helper ProcessAsync,real formatter/storage and observed binary cache entry/next cache hit;one legitimate custom-formatter input-ownership control.
permanentTestBoundary.notClaimed: No Razor page/HTTP/browser render throughput,external distributed store transport,or cross-machine endianness execution.

measurement.publicMiss: Cache eviction plus public tag-helper processing/new output,real UTF8 formatting/envelope/storage with prepared child TagHelperContent;not a complete Razor/HTTP request.
measurement.direct: Harness-only private Encode delegate bound once outside timing;inputs produced using actual framework CacheTagKey,TagHelperContent/HtmlEncoder and formatter outside timing.
measurement.controls: Actual cache hits,disabled tag-helper and real formatter-only costs;every control outcome retained.
measurement.encodedBoundaryControls: 255/256/257 and65535/65536/65537 exact encoded lengths;not claims about the loaded GC's LOH cutoff.

excludedOrUnverified: Allocation failures/process exhaustion and combined input lengths exceeding representable managed byte-array capacity are not forced on this shared machine;do not claim exact failure-type/heap-limit equivalence there.
Only Windows x64 little-endian execution is measured;unchanged BitConverter header preserves the source-level native-endian convention.
No assumed many-large-resize-copy count,exact runtime MemoryStream growth factor,production cache-miss/input frequency,external store I/O,concurrent load,or application-wide gain.
Existing deterministic owning worker-concurrency tests are preservation controls,not a performance/load result.
